# stapel-orders 0.1.0

Cart, checkout and orders over opaque purchasables. A host registers what can be bought (purchasable_type -> a keyed-batch resolver Function answering title, price, currency, availability); the cart snapshots each line when it is added, so reading a cart never calls the product owner. Checkout re-prices every line, refuses with the refreshed cart when anything drifted, and places an order idempotently on a client key, emptying the cart and announcing orders.order.placed with its lines. Orders follow a staff-driven lifecycle with buyer cancel; payment is a provider seam (none, mock) whose outcome arrives as the payment.completed fact. Checkout seams let commerce companions plug in without forking: ADJUSTERS price the cart (discounts, shipping, tax; a quote endpoint shows them before submit, order adjustments are snapshotted) and CHECKOUT_HOOKS reserve before the order is written, commit once it is placed and release on failure or cancel.

Contract: axes 2 · surface 23 · extension points 9 · operations 11 · error codes 59 · flows 4.
Generated from docs/capabilities.json by `stapel-llms-txt` — do not edit; drift-gated by `make contract-check`.

## Configuration axes — what a product switches on
Settings keys; `default` is what you get by saying nothing. Turning an axis off unmounts the operations it gates.
- CHECKOUT_REQUIRES_ACCOUNT [bool, default true] — Guest checkout
  Whether a shopper must have an account to place an order. true (default): a guest can fill a cart but is asked to sign in at checkout, and the guest cart joins the account on sign-in. false: guests can place orders too. Values: true, false.
- PAYMENT [enum, default "none"] — How orders are paid
  none (default): orders arrive unpaid and the shop confirms them by hand. mock: every order is marked paid at once with no money moving, for prototypes only. A real payment provider registers its own name. Values: none, mock.

## Usage surface — call these before writing your own
This is the answer to "does Stapel already have something for X?". `instead of` names the outside symbol this one displaces.
### gate_function
- call_seam — stapel_orders.seams.call_seam
  Call an adjuster or hook Function and validate its reply against the seam contract; raises SeamUnavailable instead of guessing, which orders turns into a 503 refusal.
- parse_errors — stapel_orders.seams.parse_errors
  Parse an adjuster's or hook's errors list into QuoteError values; malformed entries raise SeamUnavailable.
- quote — stapel_orders.seams.quote
  Run every adjuster in order over a request and return the Quote (adjustments, errors, floored total). Never raises: a silent adjuster becomes an error.503.adjuster_unavailable entry.
- resolve — stapel_orders.registry.resolve
  Resolve keys of one type in one call through the transport, validated against the purchasables contract. Raises ResolverUnavailable instead of guessing; orders answers 503 on it.
- resolve_many — stapel_orders.registry.resolve_many
  resolve() over (type, key) pairs, one call per type.
### predicate
- adjuster_entry_problem — stapel_orders.seams.adjuster_entry_problem
  Why an ADJUSTERS entry is malformed, or None; system check E006 asks it.
- get_adjusters — stapel_orders.seams.get_adjusters
  The effective adjusters (built-ins <- settings <- runtime) in application order; ask it rather than reading the setting.
- get_checkout_hooks — stapel_orders.seams.get_checkout_hooks
  The effective checkout hooks in reserve order (release runs in reverse).
- get_purchasable_types — stapel_orders.registry.get_purchasable_types
  The effective registry (built-ins <- settings <- runtime). Ask it instead of reading the setting, which misses runtime registrations.
- hook_entry_problem — stapel_orders.seams.hook_entry_problem
  Why a CHECKOUT_HOOKS entry is malformed, or None; system check E007 asks it.
- is_guest — stapel_orders.seams.is_guest
  Is this user a stapel-auth anonymous account? Adjusters and hooks then see user_id null.
- payment_names — stapel_orders.payment.payment_names
  The short names PAYMENT accepts; also the environment vocabulary.
- resolver_name — stapel_orders.registry.resolver_name
  The comm Function name that resolves a type, or UnknownPurchasableType.
### factory
- active_provider — stapel_orders.payment.active_provider
  The provider this deployment runs (orders_settings.PAYMENT).
- build_request — stapel_orders.seams.build_request
  The adjuster request for a cart's lines (currency, subtotal, lines with attrs, context); reserve adds adjustments_so_far and attempt_key to it.
- register_adjuster — stapel_orders.seams.register_adjuster
  Register or override an adjuster at runtime (None removes) — a test lever and an escape hatch; companions register through STAPEL_ORDERS['ADJUSTERS'] in their settings fragment because they never import orders.
- register_checkout_hook — stapel_orders.seams.register_checkout_hook
  Register or override a checkout hook at runtime (None removes); companions use STAPEL_ORDERS['CHECKOUT_HOOKS'] instead.
- register_payment_provider — stapel_orders.payment.register_payment_provider
  Register a payment provider under a short name PAYMENT (and the environment) may then choose. The provider starts a payment in the checkout transaction; the outcome still arrives as payment.completed.
- register_purchasable_type — stapel_orders.registry.register_purchasable_type
  Declare a purchasable type and its resolver Function from an AppConfig.ready() (or a test). The registry ships empty; this and STAPEL_ORDERS['PURCHASABLE_TYPES'] are the only two ways in, and both replace hand-building a cart for a custom product. entry=None removes a type a lower layer provided.
- reset_payment_providers — stapel_orders.payment.reset_payment_providers
  Drop registered providers — a test lever.
- reset_purchasable_types — stapel_orders.registry.reset_purchasable_types
  Drop runtime registrations, leaving settings untouched — a test lever. Product code calling it is undoing a registration that belongs in settings.
- reset_seams — stapel_orders.seams.reset_seams
  Drop runtime adjusters and hooks — a test lever.
- resolve_payment — stapel_orders.payment.resolve_payment
  Turn a PAYMENT value (short name or dotted path) into a provider; the AppSettings resolver for the key.

## Extension points — what a product replaces, fork-free
- ADJUSTERS [merge_registry]
  Price adjustments at quote and checkout. {name: {'quote': '<comm function>', 'order': int}} merged over the empty built-ins, applied by order (discounts 100, shipping 200, tax 300). Each answers {adjustments, errors} for the cart and the client's opaque context (schemas/functions/adjusters.json); total = max(0, subtotal + adjustments). Any error refuses checkout, the quote endpoint shows it; a silent adjuster is error.503.adjuster_unavailable.
- CHECKOUT_HOOKS [merge_registry]
  Reservations around checkout. {name: {'reserve', 'commit', 'release': '<comm function>'}}: reserve before the order row is written (refusal or silence refuses the checkout), commit once it is placed, release on a failed checkout, on cancel, and for crashed checkouts by the hook sweep. Idempotent on (attempt_key, name); state kept per hook in CheckoutHookState (schemas/functions/checkout_hooks.*.json).
- PAYMENT [strategy]
  How an order is paid: a short name from the payment registry (none, mock, plus register_payment_provider names) or a dotted path. The provider starts a payment inside the checkout transaction; the outcome always arrives as payment.completed, which is the only path that marks an order paid.
- PURCHASABLE_TYPES [merge_registry]
  What can be bought. {type_name: {'resolve': '<comm function>'}} merged over the empty built-ins; None removes a type. The resolver is one keyed batch for every type ({keys} -> {key: {title, price, currency, available, max_quantity, seller_id, image, url}}), so a custom app registers its product type in about twenty lines and orders never imports its model.
- STAPEL_ORDERS_CART_PRESENTER / STAPEL_ORDERS_ORDER_PRESENTER / STAPEL_ORDERS_QUOTE_PRESENTER [presenter]
  Swap keys (STAPEL_SWAP) for the cart, order and cart-quote response presenters, so a host changes what the API shows without forking a view.
- TOTAL_BASE_CONVERTER [strategy]
  Dotted path (amount, currency, base) -> Decimal | None computing Order.total_base for reporting. Default asks currencies.convert by name; no answer stores NULL, never a guess.
- orders.order.placed [comm_event]
  An order was placed; carries its lines (type, key, quantity, unit price, seller) and no personal data, so a product owner can decrement stock and a seller can be told.
- orders.order.status_changed [comm_event]
  Every lifecycle move, with the actor (owner, staff, system) and an optional reason.
- payment.completed [comm_event]
  Consumed: reference_type 'order' marks the order paid when amount and currency match its total, and sends it to needs_review when they do not.

## Fits with — fleet dependencies
- stapel-auth (optional) — the cart is keyed on request.user, and a guest is a stapel-auth anonymous account; user.merged folds a guest's cart into the account on sign-in
- stapel-core (required) — comm bus (orders.* emits, resolver and status Functions, user.merged and payment.completed consumers), AnchorPagination, GDPR owner protocol, posture stage, AppSettings
- stapel-currencies (optional) — currencies.convert fills Order.total_base for reporting; without it total_base stays NULL
- stapel-delivery (optional) — registers a shipping adjuster; reads the delivery choice from the checkout context
- stapel-inventory (optional) — registers a stock reservation checkout hook (reserve / commit / release)
- stapel-listings (optional) — answers listings.purchasables, the resolver of the 'listing' purchasable type the stapel-shop preset registers
- stapel-promotions (optional) — registers a discount adjuster and a redemption checkout hook through its settings fragment

## HTTP operations (11) — call by operationId, never by a typed path
Paths are relative to `/orders/api/v1/`.
### Orders
- DELETE /cart/ — orders_cart_clear
- POST /cart/lines/ — orders_cart_lines_create
- DELETE /cart/lines/{line_id}/ — orders_cart_lines_destroy
- PATCH /cart/lines/{line_id}/ — orders_cart_lines_update
- POST /cart/quote/ — orders_cart_quote
- GET /cart/ — orders_cart_retrieve
- POST /checkout/ — orders_checkout_create
- POST /orders/{order_id}/cancel/ — orders_orders_cancel
- GET /orders/ — orders_orders_list
- GET /orders/{order_id}/ — orders_orders_retrieve
- POST /orders/{order_id}/transition/ — orders_orders_transition
